purpose: Evaluate durability and failure-domain diversity for one already-accepted AXIOM source state without allowing replica count, mirror consensus, or placement claims to become source-lineage authority.
core_invariant: Replication proves durability and availability. It does not decide which source state AXIOM accepts.
recovery_rule: Loss or compromise of a replica never changes accepted lineage. Recovery finds a surviving digest-verified copy, reconstructs another replica, independently verifies it, records a new non-authoritative observation, and restores readiness without rewriting accepted history.
claim_boundary: This contract does not provision, synchronize, delete, or mutate a mirror.
This contract does not verify an external placement attestation signature; it consumes only placement evidence already marked verified by a separate verifier.
This contract does not make a replica, provider, majority, or transport quorum an authority over accepted source lineage.
A continuity-ready assessment proves only that supplied current evidence satisfies the configured replication policy; it does not prove unobserved physical or organizational independence.
